name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（单节点 vLLM）
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（176.9B，其中 51.2B n-gram/PLE 查找表由 NVMe 流式加载）单节点 vLLM 服务：RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint（含全视觉塔与 31 个 MTP 张量）、MTP 训练草稿头 k=3 投机、PIECEWISE CUDA-graph 捕获（PLE 查找声明为 split op）、前缀缓存默认开（共享前缀 +76%）、262,144 原生上下文（KV 池 641,601 token）、多模态 0.967；~32 tok/s 自由文本、prefill ~2,030-2,460 tok/s。源自 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark 的 longctx 路线（dev：镜像已烘焙推送 @209646c，尚未实机验证）。
description_en: Single-node vLLM serving for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176.9B, with the 51.2B n-gram/PLE lookup table streamed from NVMe): RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint (full vision tower + all 31 MTP tensors), MTP trained-draft k=3 speculation, PIECEWISE CUDA-graph capture (PLE gather declared a splitting op), prefix caching on by default (+76% shared-prefix), full 262,144 native context (641,601-token KV pool), multimodal at 0.967; ~32 tok/s free-form, prefill ~2,030-2,460 tok/s. Ported from the longctx lane of 0xBakeer/qwen38-flash-next-spark (dev: image baked & pushed @209646c, not yet verified on hardware).
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-qwen38fn:
    image: ${VLLM_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/qwen38-flash-next:v1.0.0}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-qwen38fn
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "16gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    volumes:
      # 与源 docker run 一致：宿主 HF 缓存挂到 /hf（镜像内 HF_HOME=/hf，按 HF repo id 离线解析）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/hf
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /hf
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      HF_TOKEN: "${HF_TOKEN:-}"
      # blazux PLE-mmap：51.2B n-gram 查找表由 NVMe 流式加载（本配方成立的核心开关，勿关）
      VLLM_PLE_MMAP: "1"
      VLLM_PLE_MMAP_WORKERS: "${PLE_MMAP_WORKERS:-32}"
      VLLM_PLE_MMAP_PREWARM: "${PLE_MMAP_PREWARM:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER: "1"
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"  # 冷启动读 ~83 GiB 权重，12-15 分钟
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        exec vllm serve ${QWN38_MODEL:-RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-qwen3.8-flash-next}
        --host 0.0.0.0
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --load-format safetensors
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-262144}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-16}
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.85}
        $( [ "${PREFIX_CACHE:-1}" = "1" ] && echo --enable-prefix-caching || echo --no-enable-prefix-caching )
        --enable-chunked-prefill
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}
        --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"PIECEWISE","splitting_ops":["vllm::unified_attention_with_output","vllm::unified_mla_attention_with_output","vllm::mamba_mixer2","vllm::mamba_mixer","vllm::short_conv","vllm::qwen3_8_flash_next_ple_short_conv","vllm::qwen3_8_flash_next_qsa_with_output","vllm::linear_attention","vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core","vllm::qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed","vllm::sparse_attn_indexer","vllm::ple_mmap_lookup"]}'
        --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder
        --reasoning-parser qwen3
        $( [ "${MTP:-3}" != "0" ] && printf -- '--speculative-config {"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":%s}' "${MTP:-3}" )

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: ACR 烘焙镜像（blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX 基底 + PLE-mmap 等 7 个补丁；dev 阶段待烘焙后发布）
variables.help_en: ACR-baked image (blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX base + 7 patches incl. PLE-mmap; dev — bake before publishing)

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: NVFP4 checkpoint（~122 GiB，含全视觉塔 + 31 个 MTP 张量）
variables.help_en: NVFP4 checkpoint (~122 GiB, full vision tower + all 31 MTP tensors)

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 模型原生最大窗口 262,144（gmu 0.85 下 KV 池 641,601 token）
variables.help_en: The model's native maximum, 262,144 (KV pool 641,601 tokens at gmu 0.85)

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 16 = 良好服务的并发上限；批量任务可设 64（聚合 +35%、TTFT 变差）
variables.help_en: 16 = concurrency served well; raise to 64 for batch work (+35% aggregate, worse TTFT)

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 源默认 8192；不要为前缀缓存命中而调它
variables.help_en: Upstream default 8192; do not tune it for prefix-cache hits

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 0.85（上游默认 0.78 的 KV 连一条全长请求都放不下，勿回）
variables.help_en: 0.85 (the upstream 0.78 default can't fit a single full-length request — don't revert)

variables.label: MTP 投机 token 数
variables.help: MTP 投机 k=3（>3 更差；0 = 关）；只在批未饱和时有收益
variables.help_en: MTP speculation k=3 (>3 is worse; 0 = off); pays only while the batch is unsaturated

variables.label: 前缀缓存
variables.help: 1（默认）= 前缀缓存（共享前缀 +76%）；0 = 关（复现源仓库无缓存 prefill 数字）
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = prefix caching (+76% on shared prefixes); 0 = off (reproduces the published cache-free prefill figures)

variables.label: PLE 表流式读取 worker 数
variables.help: VLLM_PLE_MMAP_WORKERS：n-gram 表 NVMe 流式预取并发的 worker 数
variables.help_en: VLLM_PLE_MMAP_WORKERS: concurrent workers prefetching the n-gram table from NVMe

variables.label: 启动预热 PLE 表
variables.help: VLLM_PLE_MMAP_PREWARM：启动时先流式读一遍表，首个请求不冷启动
variables.help_en: VLLM_PLE_MMAP_PREWARM: stream the table once at boot so the first request is not cold

variables.label: HuggingFace Token
variables.help: 受 gating 的模型授权 token；模型已由管理平台分发到缓存时通常可留空
variables.help_en: Auth token for gated models; usually empty when the model is pre-distributed to the cache
